rows.note: Use 浸浴 as the all-purpose noun for an immersion or relaxing bath in water.

example.english: What I want most when I get home is a soak.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企最想就係浸浴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 soeng2 zau6 hai6 zam3 juk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for immersing yourself or an object in liquid.

example.english: I like to soak in a hot spring after work.
example.traditional: 我放工之後鍾意浸溫泉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 zung1 ji3 zam3 wan1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this when something takes in liquid, such as a sponge or skin absorbing moisture.

example.english: The sponge can soak up all the water on the table quickly.
example.traditional: 塊海綿好快吸收晒枱面啲水。
example.jyutping: faai3 hoi2 min4 hou2 faai3 kap1 sau1 saai3 toi2 min6 di1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when liquid penetrates all the way through something, such as soaking through shoes or clothing.

example.english: My shoes started to soak through in the heavy rain.
example.traditional: 場大雨令我對鞋都浸透晒。
example.jyutping: coeng4 daai6 jyu5 ling6 ngo5 deoi3 haai4 dou1 zam3 tau3 saai3
